question: Which specific icons, pedestals, or shrine elements are covered when defilement occurs?
premises: Defilement may affect the image, pedestal, or bull mount and similar figures.
Defilement may affect that shrine or the cavity pedestal.
inference: All these specific elements are included among sites requiring expiation when defiled.
plain_english: In the image, on the pedestal, on the bull and so on, or in that shrine, or in the cavity pedestal.
